hearing_scheduling.summary: Use subject-specific OnceHub route for up to one hour after filing motion, conferring and coordinating three available choices. remote_appearances.summary: Trials/evidentiary hearings ordinarily in person in Courtroom B. chambers_communications.summary: Copy parties on scheduling email; allow two business days for booking response. No direct merits communication to judge.

cancellations.summary: Email assistant with reason and obtain approval before filing cancellation notice. Court-set hearings require stated dismissal/order route; agreement alone does not grant continuance.
